about.title: About Itqan
about.intro: Itqan is an academy for authentic Islamic knowledge and the Arabic language. We bring trusted scholars and careful teaching together on one platform, in Arabic and English.

sections.title: Our mission
sections.body: We want sound, well-sourced knowledge to be within reach of every learner, wherever they live. Itqan means mastery: we aim for lessons that are precise, clear and faithful to the sources.

sections.title: What we teach
sections.body: Courses in Tafsir, Hadith, Fiqh, Aqeedah, Seerah, Tajweed, Usool al-Fiqh and the Arabic language, from first steps to advanced study. Every course is structured into sections and lessons, with quizzes to check your understanding and a certificate when you finish.

sections.title: Our teachers
sections.body: Lessons are taught by qualified scholars and experienced teachers. Each instructor builds and maintains their own courses on Itqan, so the material stays current and connected to the person teaching it.

sections.title: Scholarly and teaching services
sections.body: Beyond courses, the Itqan team offers manuscript editing, review of books and theses, Arabic proofreading, Quran teaching and Arabic for non-native speakers. See the Services page for details.

sections.title: Get in touch
sections.body: Questions, suggestions or partnership ideas are welcome. You will find our contact details at the bottom of every page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Itqan collects, why, and the choices you have.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: Account details you give us (name, email address, and optionally phone number). Your learning activity: enrollments, completed lessons, video positions, quiz answers, reviews and certificates. Payment records (amount, status, course); card details are handled by our payment provider and never stored on our servers. Basic technical data such as your IP address, used to protect the service.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To run your account and give you access to the courses you enrolled in; to save your progress and issue certificates; to process payments and refunds; to answer your messages; and to keep the platform secure, for example by limiting repeated sign-in attempts.

sections.title: What others can see
sections.body: Reviews show your first name and the initial of your last name. A certificate page shows your name, the course and the issue date to anyone who has its link or code. Instructors see enrollment and progress figures for their own courses.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with services that help us run Itqan (such as payment processing, email delivery and file storage), and only as much as they need, or when the law requires it.

sections.title: Retention and your choices
sections.body: We keep your data while your account is active so you can return to your courses. You can update your profile at any time, and you can ask us to export or delete your account by contacting us.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use your browser's storage to keep you signed in and to remember preferences such as language and color theme. We do not use advertising trackers.

privacy.footnote: If this policy changes in a meaningful way, we will say so on this page and update the date below. Last updated: October 2026.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By creating an account or using Itqan you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: Keep your sign-in details private and give accurate information. You are responsible for activity on your account. We may suspend accounts that break these terms or put other users at risk.

sections.title: Courses and access
sections.body: Enrolling gives you personal, non-transferable access to the course for as long as it is offered on Itqan. Do not share your account, or download, copy or redistribute course videos and materials without permission.

sections.title: Payments and refunds
sections.body: Prices are shown before you pay. Paid enrollments are activated once payment is confirmed. If a payment is refunded, access to that course ends. Contact us about any billing problem.

sections.title: Reviews and conduct
sections.body: Reviews must be honest, respectful and about the course. We may hide content that is abusive, misleading or unrelated.

sections.title: Certificates
sections.body: Certificates confirm that you completed a course's lessons and quizzes on Itqan. They are not academic degrees unless a course states otherwise.

sections.title: Changes and availability
sections.body: We work to keep Itqan available and accurate, but courses and features may change over time. We may update these terms; continued use after an update means you accept the new version.
